sentences.text: Two theatre staff in scrubs prepare an operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital for spinal surgery, with one smoothing a pillow on the operating table beside an intraoperative C-arm imaging system.

Over-the-shoulder view of a theatre staff member in a patterned scrub cap looking into an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with an operating table and a robotic C-arm imaging system ready for spinal surgery.
Shot 3

Low-angle view of an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, showing a mobile robotic intraoperative imaging system beside the operating table, with a patient monitor and anaesthetic equipment in the background. The camera moves slowly across the room.

Low-angle moving shot of an empty hybrid operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, showing a ceiling-mounted X-ray C-arm positioned over the operating table, with patient monitors and an anaesthetic machine in the background.

Low, slow camera move past an empty operating table toward a robotic C-arm X-ray system in a hybrid theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with ceiling-mounted monitors and storage cabinets in the background.
Slow camera move along an empty operating table under a C-arm X-ray unit in a theatre, with a patient monitor in the background. No people are in the shot.

An empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital with a C-arm X-ray imaging system arched over an operating table, ready for a spinal procedure. The camera moves slowly past the table, with monitors and theatre equipment in the background.

Camera moves past an anaesthetic machine in an operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital to reveal three theatre staff in blue scrubs and caps standing around the operating table, with one smiling towards the camera.
Shot 10

A theatre team member in blue scrubs and a head covering sits at the head of an empty operating table in an operating theatre, looking ahead as she prepares. The camera moves past a blurred foreground object, briefly obscuring the view in the middle of the shot.

A theatre staff member in blue scrubs and a patterned scrub cap sits behind an operating table in an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with equipment trolleys and theatre lights around her. The camera tracks sideways behind blurred foreground objects that wipe in and out of frame.

A theatre team member in blue scrubs and a patterned scrub cap sits at the back of an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, seen past the operating table as the camera tracks sideways under the theatre light arm.

A theatre staff member in navy scrubs and a lead thyroid shield adjusts the illuminated dials on an equipment control panel in a clinical area at The Harborne Hospital. The camera moves from her face down to close on her hands turning the knobs.

A staff member in navy scrubs, a patterned scrub cap and a lead thyroid collar adjusts the dials on an X-ray (C-arm) control panel in an operating theatre. The camera moves up from her hands to her face as she looks across the room.

Close-up of a theatre team member in blue scrubs adjusting dials and the touchscreen on a control panel in an operating theatre. The camera then moves to show the staff member wearing a lead thyroid collar.

An empty hybrid operating theatre with a robotic C-arm X-ray system, operating table and patient monitors at The Harborne Hospital. A staff member in navy scrubs and a surgical cap walks through the room at the start of the shot.

An empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital with a robotic C-arm imaging system beside the operating table, used for intraoperative imaging during spinal surgery. The camera moves low around the C-arm, with patient monitors and an anaesthetic machine in the background.

Empty hybrid operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital with a robotic C-arm X-ray system positioned over the operating table, with an anaesthetic machine and monitors in the background. The camera moves slowly across the room past the foot of the table.

Low-angle view of an empty hybrid operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with a robotic C-arm X-ray system positioned over the operating table as the camera moves slowly past. A patient monitor and anaesthetic equipment are in the background.

Low-angle view of an empty hybrid operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with a robotic C-arm imaging system positioned over the operating table and an anaesthetic machine and monitors in the background. The camera moves slowly across the room.

Empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital with an operating table, a robotic C-arm X-ray system and ceiling-mounted patient monitors, filmed from a low angle as the camera glides slowly past the table.

A robotic C-arm X-ray imaging system moves into position beside an empty operating table in a hybrid operating theatre, with ceiling-mounted monitors and anaesthetic equipment in the background. Intraoperative imaging setup for spinal surgery at The Harborne Hospital.

A staff member in navy scrubs walks along a hospital corridor and through doors marked CT, following a colleague in a maroon uniform carrying a clipboard into the CT scanner room at The Harborne Hospital.

Two staff members, one in blue scrubs and one in a maroon tunic, talk beside a Siemens CT scanner, then the camera moves through the scanner bore towards the imaging room doors at The Harborne Hospital.

Shot framed from inside a scanner bore as two staff members, a man in navy scrubs and a woman in a maroon tunic holding a clipboard, come through the doors into the imaging room. She gestures him toward the scanner.
Shot through the bore of a CT scanner as a patient sits on the scanner table and lies back, guided by a staff member holding a clipboard, ahead of a spinal scan at The Harborne Hospital.

A staff member in a maroon uniform prepares a patient lying on a Siemens CT scanner table. The patient raises his arms above his head and she uses the gantry touchscreen to set up the scan, with a contrast injector beside them.
A staff member uses the controls on a Siemens CT scanner while a patient lies on the scanner table with their arms raised above their head, ready for a scan at The Harborne Hospital.

Two radiographers in an MRI control room review scan images on the console while a colleague in navy scrubs looks on. One taps the scanner touchscreen, and a monitor in the background shows the camera feed of the patient in the MRI scanner.
A nurse in a maroon uniform and a colleague in navy scrubs sit together at a nurses' station at The Harborne Hospital, looking at a computer screen and discussing what they see.
A nurse in a burgundy uniform works at a computer at a nurses' station while a colleague in navy scrubs sits beside her and watches the screen, at The Harborne Hospital.

A nurse in a burgundy uniform and a colleague in blue scrubs work together at a computer at a nurses' station at The Harborne Hospital. He points to the screen, and they talk and smile as they go through information.
Two radiographers in scrubs talk and work at the CT control room console, reviewing axial scan images on monitors while a patient lies on the CT scanner table seen through the control room window.

A consultant in a white shirt examines a male patient's arm in a hospital bed, moving and holding the arm to assess strength and movement as part of a spinal care assessment in a room with patient monitoring and infusion equipment.
